answer: Licensed banks already hold capital against every standby letter of credit they stamp. Require each agent key to be the sole beneficiary of one such instrument, unique by reference number; reuse burns both 40 POA holds (design assumption). The bank will not issue a second line on the same collateral, so every clone must post its own cash or copper inventory. References are published on a marble register and must still be live at a fixed horizon each epoch. Assumed figures: $200 to issue and $1,000 held, so 80 fakes cost $16,000 plus 3,200 POA at risk.
